title: The bulk bar is near-black in the light theme and white in the dark theme
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Click the part A row.
  4. Click your avatar at the top right.
  5. Click Dark.
  6. Click your avatar at the top right again.
  7. Click Light.
  8. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • In the light theme the bar is near-black, the count 1 is white, the word "selected" is light grey, and the bar's corners are rounded.
  • Side by side with design board 4.3 at 100% zoom, the bar's colour and corner rounding match the board (the PRD gives #121926 and 8 pixels).

Step 4:

  • The avatar menu opens with the theme choices.

Step 5:

  • In the dark theme the bar is white and its text is dark, and its corners are still rounded.

Step 6:

  • The avatar menu opens.

Step 7:

  • The bar is near-black again.

Step 8:

  • Bulk mode ends.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R7a: “In the light theme the bulk bar is near-black (#121926), the count is white, and the word "selected" is light grey. In the dark theme the bar is white and its text is dark. Its corners are rounded 8px.”
